title: ABAC DENY policies support AI securables and attachment to individual objects (Beta)
body:
* **Expanded `FOR` clause support:** DENY policies can now apply to model services, model provider services, MCP services, agent services, and skills.
* **Expanded `ON` clause support:** DENY policies can now be attached directly on tables, volumes, functions, models, secrets, model services, model provider services, MCP services, agent services, and skills.

See [Supported securable types and privileges](/aws/en/data-governance/unity-catalog/abac/deny-policies#supported-types).
